text:
Roman Josi got to 800 career points on Wednesday in Anaheim, setting up Shane Wright's first goal as a Predator, and the Predators say no Swiss player had reached the mark before him. It came in the middle of a six-game winning streak, with Josi still logging 25.5 minutes a night at 36.

The season line is excellent: 22 points in 19 games, 20 of them assists, 11 on the power play. Some of it is borrowed. Nashville has scored 10.3 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, and his scoring rate sits above the top of our talent range for him. His own shot has gone cold the other way: two goals on 51 shots, 3.9%, under the 6.4% a typical defenseman shoots.

What's real is how he moves the puck. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying it in on 44% of his entries last season, and the Predators' share of five-on-five expected goals is 6.7 points higher with him than without. Daily Hive floated him this week as a possible Edmonton trade target; for now he is the engine of a team that has won six straight.
headline: Roman Josi reaches 800 in a six-game run
